`final class JOIDLog`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [JOIDLog.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/JOIDLog.java)

Prints the messages of JOID with the [JOID] prefix, information on the standard output and warnings on the error output.

## Description

Every warning on [the errors page](/reference/errors/) goes through `JOIDLog`.
The `warnOnce` and `devWarnOnce` methods print a message once per key for the whole run, so that a warning raised on every frame appears a single time.
